description: Canonical registry of dummy/placeholder API key values used in configs that cannot reference SOPS secrets or environment variables. All hardcoded sk- style literals in the tracked tree must resolve to a registered value (enforced by check step 13 run_dummy_key_uniformity).

$schema.description: Reference to the JSON Schema file that validates this data file.

consumers.description: Repo-relative paths of configs that use this value.

note.description: Why this dummy key exists and what it gates.

value.description: The canonical dummy key literal (e.g. sk-nucleus-*).

dummyKeys.description: Named dummy keys. Keys are stable identifiers; values are the literals consumers must use.
